title: Hydroxide-promoted transformation of fluorotelomer carboxylic acids at ambient temperature
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2026, 28,1511-1520

Fluorotelomer carboxylic acids (FTCAs) are key intermediates in the environmental transformation of fluorotelomer-based precursors, yet their abiotic degradation pathways remain poorly understood.
